risks.quote: GenAI assisted learning and assessment should be so designed as to not perpetuate biases or inequalities;

responsibilities.quote: It is the student’s responsibility to use the required academic integrity guidance and follow lecturers’ instructions.
Students are expected to inform themselves, by reading and complying with relevant guidelines and policies.
The University shall ensure that staff and students are offered training and development opportunities, so they are appropriately informed about, and accountable for, any GenAI based
Academics are responsible for maintaining a balance between GenAI automation and human oversight, for example in creating educational material or assessments;
The use of GenAI should align with SETU’s ethical values and standards;
student data and privacy must be maintained through compliance with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and best practice. This includes the inputting of such data to produce a GenAI response;
This policy will be reviewed in advance of the review date, every 3 years from approval date and/or as soon as possible following new or updated legislation, national or sectoral policy.
